description: This file defines a step definitions class for Cucumber tests related to batch request handling in the Apache Fineract project. It contains test setup methods that mock interactions with the BatchApiService and verify its behavior when handling batch requests without enclosing transactions.

classes.name: BatchBuilderWithoutEnclosingTransactionStepDefinitions
classes.description: A Cucumber step definitions class for testing batch request handling without enclosing transactions in Apache Fineract.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes Cucumber step definitions with mocked BatchApiService, UriInfo, and a sample BatchRequest list, setting up steps for testing batch request handling.
